newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close lower in range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close lower in range-bound trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks, which began a correction on Thursday, closed lower on Friday as profit-taking outpaced buying, brokers said.
The all-share index closed 2.7 points down at 793.3, on turnover of 76.6 million rupees.
"The index easing marginally today in comparison with Thursday's 10-point fall is an indication that it could start moving up again before long," said Aslem Ahmed of CDIC Sasoon.
"The fact that there still is foreign buying interest in pricey blue chips and good growth expectations for the period to end June should move the market up again before long," he added.
